LESSON: RELATIONSHIP

Grade: PP2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1.4: Relationship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Relationship. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use Masjid as a place of worship drawing of a Masjid and recite poems on Masjid of worship within their environment 203

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use Masjid as a place of worship drawing of a Masjid and recite poems on Masjid of worship within their environment 203
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use Masjid as a place of worship drawing of a Masjid and recite poems on Masjid of worship within their environment 203. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Relationship.
2. Explain Relationship to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Relationship.
4. Show that you can: use Masjid as a place of worship drawing of a Masjid and recite poems on Masjid of worship within their environment 203
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Relationship. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Relationship important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. use Masjid as a place of worship drawing of a Masjid and recite poems on Masjid of worship within their environment 203

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
